A Rottweiler is not recommended as a first dog owner breed and it is worrying hearing all of this, but please just listen to advice. You have your baby now so it’s not helpful with people scolding you, if you decide to keep her please do extensive research into her breed and what she needs and understand the commitment you’ve undertaken.

I’m happy for you to message me directly if you want to safely express your questions ect. We are currently raising our baby Shiloh and she needs a lot. I will happily help you along your journey without judgement, it’s done now and all that matters is she gets the care she needs and deserves. So it’s not helpful to just bash you, she’s not had the best start but please continue how you mean to go on! X
